# Flight Recorder examples

Open an HTML file locally. Every view is generated only after strict package import. Use flight_recorder.py inspect/view/redact to recheck or export.

retained-* are existing real provider captures on their recorded older revisions. new-* are newly executed instrumented socket captures on the exact revision in each package. synthetic-missing-evidence removes receiver loss availability; synthetic-contradictory-evidence adds one receiver drop to the loss case while unique delivery counters retain full recovery. They are derived fixtures, not new provider measurements.

Case IDs and pseudonyms intentionally change on regeneration; observations and expected results do not. SHA-256 checks detect corruption, not malicious reauthoring. No media payloads are retained.
